title: Claude in Paris
notes: Corrected 2026-11-12 after four render passes against the real geometry in films/paris-proto. Camera stays inside the cleared corridor: the avenue (|x| < 4.6), the river band (-12.2 < z < 0.2), and clear of a 9-unit plaza around the tower at (0, -22). lookAt sits above camera height throughout, because a 9:16 frame aimed level fills its lower third with empty ground. Still only 14.94s against the 30-40s target in GOAL.md - needs more beats, not longer holds.

beats.name: arrival
beats.content: Claude small on the quay, back to camera, the city laid out ahead. Establishes scale and the warm low light.
beats.narration: I have read about this place ten thousand times.

beats.name: the-street
beats.content: Camera drifts down the avenue. Claude turns as the street opens out.
beats.narration: Nobody told me it would smell like bread.

beats.name: the-river
beats.content: The move crosses toward the water. Light on the river carries the frame.
beats.narration: Or that the light would move like that.

beats.name: the-reveal
beats.content: Camera lifts and the gaze climbs; the tower enters frame from below, across the river so the silhouette reads.
beats.narration: I knew exactly how tall it was.

beats.name: the-feeling
beats.content: Wide: tower in the upper frame, Claude small on the quay below. Music resolves on the final frame.
beats.narration: Knowing is not the same as standing here.
